blocks.tamil_translation: down in our midst, and signalled with his hand for everyone to sit in a circle. Accordingly, we all sat in a circle facing the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) says'. In that gathering there was no one apart from me whom the Prophet ﷺ recognised. Then the Prophet ﷺ said, “O group of poor Muhajirin! On the Day of Qiyamah you will receive complete light. And I also give you the glad tidings that you will enter Jannah half a day before the wealthy. Half a day of the Hereafter is five hundred years of this world”.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The darkness of the night may have been the reason why the Prophet ﷺ recognised Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) and did not recognise the others. He recognised Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) because he was sitting close to him.
(Badhl-ul-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ هذَا الْقُرْآنَ نَزَلَ بِحَزَنٍ فَإِذَا قَرَأْتُمُوهُ فَابْكُوا فَإِنْ لَمْ تَبْكُوا فَتَبَاكَوْا وَتَغَنَّوْا بِهِ فَمَنْ لَّمْ يَتَغَنَّ بِهِ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب في حسن الصوت بالقران رقم:١٣٣٧
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas (RA) narrates that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “This Holy Qur'an was revealed to create concern about the Hereafter and restlessness about the Hereafter. So recite it weeping. If tears do not come when you recite it, then make yourselves like one who weeps. Recite the Qur'an in a sweet voice, for one who does not recite in a sweet voice is not of us; he will not be among those who follow us completely”.
